summary: Per-frame AI pit-entry check: queries the fuel multiplier via FuelMultiplierValue; when the multiplier is below 1 (low fuel), the pit-requested flag at this[0x4550] is still clear, and the race phase (dword_7C56A8) equals 5 (pit window), forces a pit exit. Returns the last computed value otherwise. Called once per frame from AIAbility.

local_names.result: fuel multiplier from FuelMultiplierValue, or the pit-requested flag this[0x4550]

operations.description: FuelMultiplierValue(this) queries the current fuel level multiplier; its return value gates the pit logic below.
When the fuel multiplier result >= 1 (fuel still OK) the pit-forcing path is skipped and the multiplier is returned unchanged.
Pit forcing proceeds only when this[0x4550] == 0, i.e. a pit stop has not already been requested.
Pit forcing proceeds only when dword_7C56A8 == 5, the race phase corresponding to the pit window.
ForcePitExit(this) is invoked to force the pit exit when all three guards pass. The callee is named only in the raw source; no address is evidenced for it in this packet.
Return the current result value (the fuel multiplier, the pit-requested flag, or the outcome of the forced pit-exit path).

unresolved: ForcePitExit is named only in the raw source text; its call target address is absent from the packet and cannot be stated.
The return-value contract (fuel multiplier vs pit-requested flag vs force result) depends on caller interpretation.
